system.story: The counter-caster - the crew's answer to the Dark One's incursions.

description.value:
Subclass: Exorcist (the anti-spirit / anti-corruption specialist). The Veil specialist and counter-caster.

Role Feature - Rite of Banishment

Bonus to banishment, warding against incursion, sensing/dispelling corruption and possession, and fighting spirits, the corrupted, and dark entities specifically (edges vs those foes; stronger Sense the Veil and Banish). Your Banish/anti-spirit rolls are enhanced, and you can dispel or suppress a hostile working.

Signature Pact-Summon

A hunting/binding spirit - tracks and holds spirit-foes.

Corp Records

Containment / counter-thaumic specialist.
